scope: Local synthetic UI only; no product fixes, issue filing or provider acceptance.

findings.title: Failed selected-drive listing continues to say Loading files
findings.expected: Once the listing request has failed, stop the loading state and distinguish failure from a genuinely empty drive.
findings.actual: A simulated503 displayed an error banner but the table continued saying Loading files; Refresh recovered100 real rows after removing interception.
reproduction: Open Files in the populated synthetic Harbor Research owner.
Use a browser-only route interception to return503 for the selected drive listing; click Refresh.
Observe the error banner together with Loading files in the table.
Remove the interception and Refresh to recover the populated listing.
findings.simulation: Browser-only listing503; not an actual database or storage outage.

findings.title: Loaded-page filter gives a blank table without no-match guidance
findings.expected: Explain that no currently loaded rows match and preserve a clear path to loading more; do not imply a global server search.
findings.actual: Filtering zoning-summary before loading page2 left a blank table without no-match guidance. Loading the next page exposed the real target. The Filter loaded files label is truthful but easy to miss.
reproduction: Select Harbor Research with only its first100 metadata rows loaded.
Enter zoning-summary in Filter loaded files.
Observe a blank table; click Load more files and the matching later row appears.

findings.title: Billing save/error feedback is outside the form viewport
findings.expected: After submitting spending controls, feedback should be discoverable at or near the controls, or focus/scroll should reliably reveal it.
findings.actual: Save/error banners rendered near the page top while the controls remained lower down. The user had to scroll upward to see the required-email error or save result.
reproduction: Open Billing and limits and scroll to spending controls.
Provide a threshold but leave Alert email empty; click Save spending controls.
Observe no nearby error, then scroll to the top to find the banner.

findings.title: Required billing email error exposes API field names
findings.expected: Name the visible Alert email and Email me at controls in actionable user-facing language.
findings.actual: The required-email validation banner uses internal API field names rather than the displayed form labels.
reproduction: Set Email me at to a valid amount and leave Alert email empty.
Submit and scroll upward to read the required-email banner.

findings.title: Escape closes the create-drive dialog without returning focus to its trigger
findings.expected: After Escape closes a closable dialog opened from New drive, return keyboard focus to that invoking button.
findings.actual: The dialog closed but document.activeElement was BODY rather than the New drive button. Occasional BODY during Tab cycling was separately adjudicated as browser-chrome cycling, not an app control escaping the modal.
reproduction: In the isolated empty synthetic owner's Files view, focus New drive.
Press Enter to open Create a drive and use Tab to inspect focus.
Press Escape; observe closed dialog and BODY as active element.
findings.limitation: Chromium observation only; not a screen-reader or cross-browser accessibility certification.

geometry_adjudication.intentional_scrolling: Narrow tables and console navigation scroll independently; not document overflow.
false_positives: Uneven row flags grouped unrelated nav/header/table elements.
Wrapped control on settings error was the focusable audit-table region.
Native select text truncation is distinct from inaccessible document overflow.
geometry_adjudication.limitations: Representative layouts only. Error/form/loading states not all repeated at every width; no exhaustive visual or accessibility certification.
